correctness.rationale: Exact companion matrix identity A^10=I+4B, explicit first two binomial coefficients, and integer-valued divided-difference valuation inequalities prove four surjective scaled dyadic isometries. value.rationale: The natural complete value-set invariant for classical Tetranacci numbers at every power of two is determined by four dyadic balls and an exact Haar measure 5/8. This gives a universal local representability criterion and pinpoints forbidden classes, unlike merely knowing recurrence periods or enumerated moduli.
